principle: Single source of the paths that must NEVER leave into a public subtree-split child repo or a published dist/image. The encrypted secrets vault lives in git for the owner's private clone + CI decrypt, but its ciphertext must not be republished (git history + split child repos would retain old ciphertext forever). check_sops_secrets.py asserts every path here is honored by BOTH the subtree-split tooling and the published-dist ignore (.dockerignore).
